content: Emaho!May the Victors of the ten directions and their spiritual heirs, without exception, heed this.By the virtue I have accumulated throughout the three times, exemplified by this,Gathered as one, I dedicate it to all who have a karmic connection,Whether positive or negative, to guide them all.May all, through this virtue, attain the supreme bliss,And in a single lifetime, dredge the depths of samsara to attain Buddhahood.May the collection of pure, white virtue I have amassed,Be sealed by the pure samadhi of non-objectification.To all beings wandering in the samsara of ignorance,I dedicate this just as the Victors and their heirs have dedicated.By the power of the truth of the Guru, the Victors, and their heirs,May all beings find their purpose in the essence of enlightenment.Through the secret path of the sky-treasury of dharmatā,I realize the naked nature of samsara and nirvana.From the beginning, the kayas and primordial wisdom are inseparable;By this, I dedicate infinite virtue to all beings.May all beings be completely cleansed of the obscurations of ignorance,And reach the ground of the enlightenment of the three kayas.Through the secret path of my own awareness of dharmatā,The collection of uncontaminated virtue, free from the three spheres of objectification,I dedicate to all beings, as vast as the sky.May all beings be free from suffering and attain Buddhahood.I take upon myself the sins, obscurations, and sufferings of beings;May they overflow into the play of the primordially pure, luminous clarity, free from obscuration.Aho!May all sentient beings, as vast as the limits of space,Until the time they attain Buddhahood,Find that the engagement of my three doors becomesAn inexhaustible source of sustenance for all beings.In the dark realm of beings' bewildered ignorance,May the sun of pristine awareness shine forth.For all beings suffering from the burning heat of misery,May the cooling moonbeams of compassion descend,And may those impoverished of the noble wealthAttain the wish-fulfilling state of enlightened qualities.In short, for all mother-beings as vast as the limits of space,May every desired resource appear before each one,The supreme emanated teacher who dispels all suffering,Having performed inconceivable and countless emanations,Dispels all temporary suffering and establishes beings in bliss,May he dredge the depths of the three realms of cyclic existence.Ho! From the basic space of primordial purity and original liberation,The secret path of spontaneously present, fully liberated awareness,Within the state where self, other, and the three spheres are baseless and rootless,May the glory of the fruition of the three kayas and enlightenment be attained.This was written in haste by one bearing the name Gser-thang-ba Sa-ga-ra, who is ignorant of all, at Rtse-brgya Monastery on the twenty-second day of the twelfth month of the Fire Mouse year.
